ash.extensions.tryDifferent: Try a different search or clear the current filters.
ash.extensions.installDescription: Install Plugins, Skills, MCP servers, language support, and themes from the signed catalog.
ash.extensions.officialMcp: Listed in the official MCP Registry · {name}@{version}
ash.extensions.declarativeOnly: Installation loads supported themes, syntax and snippets without running scripts. Enable or disable the whole extension in its details. JavaScript execution requires separate authorization.
ash.extensions.accessibilityHelp: Extensions, Plugins, Skills, MCP Servers and Recommended are collapsible panes. Use Left and Right on headers to collapse or expand them. Open /extensions to browse and manage extensions. Use Tab to move between controls, arrow keys to select an extension, and Enter to open its details. Enable or Disable in a row or its details controls the whole editor extension, including scripts, themes, syntax and snippets. Language packs are managed through the display language setting. Execution authorization and permissions are reviewed separately in details. Escape closes this help. Run Install plugin from Git repository in the Command Palette to choose a repository revision and package directory. Press Escape during installation to cancel.
ash.extensions.localExtensionPath: Enter the extension package path relative to the selected workspace directory.
ash.extensions.localExtensionInstallNotice: The package must contain .ash-plugin/plugin.json. Installation copies the package into your profile; enablement and permissions are managed separately.
ash.extensions.localExtensionInstalled: Installed {0} {1}. Use Manage local extensions to enable it and review its permissions.
ash.extensions.noLocalExtensions: No local editor extensions are installed. Use Install extension from workspace to add one.
ash.extensions.localExtensionDocumentNotice: VS Code extensions use the product Node host with user-level filesystem, network and child-process access and inherited developer environment variables. Editor callbacks can receive unsaved text. Grant permissions only to packages you trust.
ash.extensions.noEditorExtensions: No editor extensions are installed. Install one from the Open VSX catalog first.
ash.extensions.noExecutableEntry: Script execution is unavailable for this package or platform.
ash.extensions.extensionsExecutionNotice: Authorize this exact extension to run in the product Node host with your user-level filesystem, network and child-process access, including inherited developer environment variables. Editor APIs receive documents including unsaved text. Package or execution-contract changes require new authorization.
ash.extensions.sourceSetup: Enter the registry endpoints and trusted signing root provided by its publisher.
ash.extensions.sourceIdentity: Choose a unique source ID. Package identities are scoped to this source. Its endpoints and signing root cannot be replaced under the same ID.
ash.extensions.verbosityDescription: Announce keyboard help when Extensions receives focus.
ash.extensions.focusHint: Extensions. Use Tab to navigate and Alt+F1 for help.
ash.extensions.extensionMissing: This extension is no longer installed. Refresh Extensions.
ash.extensions.languagePackEnablement: Language packs are managed through the display language setting and cannot be disabled.
ash.extensions.backendUnavailable: This provider is unavailable on the connected backend.
ash.extensions.recommendationsObject: The recommendations configuration must be an object.
ash.extensions.recommendationsIds: Recommendations must be arrays of at most 1000 extension IDs.
ash.extensions.recommendationUnavailable: This recommendation is currently unavailable from the enabled extension sources.
ash.extensions.workspaceRecommendationsEmpty: Add recommendations to .ash/extensions.json or the extensions field in the workspace file.
ash.extensions.recommendationsNoWorkspace: Open a workspace to see its recommendations.
ash.extensions.detailsHelp: These are the selected extension, plugin, skill or MCP server details. The header contains identity and actions. Use Tab to reach the tabs, then Left and Right to move and Enter to select. Details shows the description or README; other tabs show features, permissions, tools or skill instructions and diagnostics. Additional information is beside the content and moves below it in a narrow editor. Open package opens the owning package for installation and permission management. MCP server details show backend connection status and diagnostics. Refresh reloads server status.
ash.extensions.gitInstallWorkspace: Open a workspace folder to install a plugin from Git.
ash.extensions.gitInstallFolder: Choose the workspace folder for the temporary checkout
ash.extensions.gitInstallSource: Enter the repository URL, optional branch, tag or full commit ID, and package directory.
ash.extensions.gitInstallNotice: The package directory defaults to the repository root and must contain .ash-plugin/plugin.json. Installation uses a temporary checkout in {0}; enablement and permissions are managed separately.
ash.extensions.gitReference: Branch, tag or full commit ID (optional)
ash.extensions.gitInstallProgress: Installing plugin from Git. Press Escape to cancel.
ash.extensions.invalidGitPackagePath: Enter a package path within the repository, using forward slashes.
ash.extensions.unsafeGitPackageEntry: The package contains a symbolic link or unsupported file: {0}
ash.extensions.mcpStatusReadFailed: Could not load MCP server status: {0}
ash.extensions.capabilityHelp: Extensions contains collapsible Extensions, Plugins, Skills, MCP Servers and Recommended panes. Use Left and Right on a pane header to collapse or expand it, and Up and Down to move between headers. Search within a pane, use arrow keys to select an item, and Enter to open details in the editor. Skill enablement and diagnostics are in its details. Package installation, permissions and removal are in package details. Refresh reloads the current catalog. Run Install plugin from Git repository in the Command Palette to choose a repository revision and package directory. Press Escape during installation to cancel. MCP server details show backend connection status and diagnostics. Refresh reloads server status.
